title: Add RAG prompt-variant tester wizard and docsite integration
author: Ava Morales
release_notes: Introduces a new interactive prompt-variant tester wizard (docs + example) that lets engineers run curated prompt families against a local/hosted Retriever+LLM stack and generate structured comparison reports. No breaking changes.
description: Motivation: teams building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) features need a lightweight way to iterate on prompt variants, assert structured-output contracts, and compare quality/latency trade-offs without wiring a full eval infra. This PR adds an opinionated prompt-variant tester wizard (docs + example) that developers can run locally or in CI to surface regressions and guide prompt tuning. Checklist: - [x] Docs page (mdx) with walkthrough and CLI quickstart - [x] Example repo with variants YAML and run script - [x] Interactive tester component embedded in docsite (static-backed interactivity) - [x] Structured output assertion examples and reporter - [x] E2E smoke test for local run - [x] Telemetry probe hooks (optional) Design notes: the tester is intentionally small: it takes a YAML of prompt templates + named variants + sample queries, runs each variant against a configured endpoint (local dev server or Redwood hosted endpoint), and emits a JSON report and human-friendly summary. The docsite integration demonstrates embedding a read-only interactive UI backed by example payloads so readers can explore variant diffs inline. Usage summary: 1) cd examples/rag/prompt-variant-tester 2) Fill variants.yaml with prompt templates and expected structured-output keys 3) ./run-local.sh --endpoint http://localhost:8080 --out report.json 4) open docs/rag/prompt-variant-tester.mdx for guidance and embedded examples Internals: - reporter consolidates token-level latency, output shape matches, a top-level quality score heuristic (configurable), and raw outputs for per-case inspection. - assertions support JSONPath checks and approximate string-similarity thresholds. - telemetry hooks emit minimal anonymized metrics when REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=1; telemetry is opt-in in examples. Related work: references ENG-8432 (prompt tuning ergonomics) and PM-112 (docs initiative). This is documented in docs/rag/prompt-variant-tester.mdx and linked from docs/_sidebar.yml.
